scientific_limitations: Finite Galois sets for genus-two Jacobian Kummer quartics over odd finite fields; not full Kummer zeta or integral divisor lattice. Some existing broad symmetry results may implicitly determine the arithmetic cycles. A December 2008 preprint exists with unverified day; first precisely dated inspected public source is the September 29, 2009 arXiv posting. All scientific assertions have only self-review; independent audit unperformed.
title: Frobenius orbit spectra of Göpel and Rosenhain tetrads on genus-two Jacobian Kummer quartics
